production_sale_approved_check.name: production_sale_approved_check
production_sale_approved_check.value: ("production"."sale_review" <> 'DRAFT' or "production"."sale_approved_at" is null) and ("production"."sale_review" not in ('APPROVED', 'SUSPENDED') or "production"."sale_approved_at" is not null)

production_approved_place_check.name: production_approved_place_check
production_approved_place_check.value: "production"."sale_approved_at" is null or "production"."place_id" is not null

section_range_check.name: section_range_check
section_range_check.value: ("section"."seat_index_from" is null) = ("section"."seat_index_to" is null) and ("section"."seat_index_from" is null or ("section"."seat_index_from" >= 0 and "section"."seat_index_from" <= "section"."seat_index_to"))

venue_owner_check.name: venue_owner_check
venue_owner_check.value: ("venue"."kind" = 'LAYOUT') = ("venue"."promoter_id" is not null) and ("venue"."kind" = 'LAYOUT' or "venue"."template_venue_id" is null)

venue_canvas_check.name: venue_canvas_check
venue_canvas_check.value: ("venue"."canvas_width" is null or "venue"."canvas_width" between 1 and 100000) and ("venue"."canvas_height" is null or "venue"."canvas_height" between 1 and 100000)
